name: git-safety
description: Branch-aware git guardrails for Claude Code. A PreToolUse hook on Bash that denies destructive git and gh CLI operations before they run: pushing to main/master, deleting protected branches, commit/merge/rebase/reset/push while on a protected branch, and gh pr merge/close, issue close, release delete, repo delete. Three safety levels (critical/high/strict) selectable via HOOK_SAFETY_LEVEL; every block is logged.
